title: Q1: How does row-level filtering optimize storage while securing multi-tenant datasets?

objective: Evaluate query optimization and security mechanics.

options.text: By duplicating physical tables for each distinct user role and department
By executing parameterized predicate pushdowns to restrict visibility dynamically
By encrypting individual cell values with static organization keys
By converting operational parquet files into immutable CSV archives

explanation: B. Predicate pushdowns evaluate filters at query parse time against session context functions without altering physical files. Explain how Spark catalyst optimizer injects filter predicates dynamically.

title: Q2: Which mechanism applies dynamic masking functions to sensitive columns based on user group membership?

options.text: Static schema migration scripts executed during daily batch ingest
Manual view creation with hardcoded CASE statements per user
Unity Catalog column masking functions evaluated at query execution time
Azure Key Vault secrets rotation applied during storage reads

explanation: C. Unity Catalog column masks are defined using SQL functions referencing current_user() or is_account_group_member() to transform column outputs on the fly without rewriting underlying Delta tables.

title: Q3: When configuring a row filter function in Unity Catalog, which SQL built-in function identifies the authenticated user principal?

options.text: system.client.user_id
current_user()
az_identity_principal()
spark.session.user

explanation: B. current_user() is the standard Spark SQL function utilized within row filter predicates to determine the calling principal's email or identity string.

title: Q4: What is the primary operational advantage of implementing dynamic row filters over static view creation?
subtitle: Fine-grained access policies enforce compliance without administrative sprawl.
objective: Assess architectural benefits of dynamic policies over views.

options.text: Elimination of compute cluster resource consumption
Direct storage encryption key rotation at rest
Elimination of view proliferation and centralized policy manageability
Bypassing Azure Active Directory token expiration limits

explanation: C. Creating separate views for every department creates view sprawl. Dynamic row filters attach directly to the underlying table, allowing a single table to serve multiple secured segments.

title: Q5: How should a column mask function be structured to display only the last four digits of a Social Security Number to standard analysts?
subtitle: Column masking logic preserves data utility while neutralizing privacy risks.
objective: Test SQL syntax for conditional column masking functions.

ALTER TABLE secure_table DROP COLUMN ssn WHERE role != 'HR'
ENCRYPT(ssn, 'AES256') WITH KEY vault_secret
MASK ssn USING 'XXXX' FOR ALL USERS EXCEPT HR

explanation: A. Unity Catalog masks utilize standard SQL conditional logic combined with group membership evaluation functions to conditionally transform column outputs.
